title: Implement realtime session reconciliation & event routing
description: Extend `unmute/main_websocket.py` (receive_loop/emit_loop) plus `unmute/unmute_handler.py` to accept the full set of client events (`session.update`, `response.create/cancel`, `conversation.item.*`, `input_audio_buffer.commit/reset`, etc.), maintain per-session state machines, and emit the required acknowledgements (`*.updated`, `response.completed`, `response.failed`, `conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.*`). Ensure recorder persistence stays deterministic when clients reconnect. Add async tests using FastAPI TestClient + in-memory handler stubs to simulate event sequences and verify state reconciliation + ack ordering.

title: Refactor realtime websocket handshake & capability negotiation
description: Modify `unmute/main_websocket.py` websocket_route() and supporting auth/config helpers to enforce the OpenAI Realtime subprotocol, verify capability negotiation payloads (e.g., `unmute.extensions`), validate auth tokens/config metadata, and persist negotiated session state on the handler. Ensure failure paths emit proper `error` server events and close with relevant status codes. Cover handshake/capability permutations with integration-style tests (FastAPI TestClient + websocket).,timeout:120000,

title: Expand OpenAI Realtime event models
description: Map all documented OpenAI Realtime client/server events to Pydantic models in `unmute/openai_realtime_api_events.py`, including conversation items, response lifecycle, tool-call payloads, image buffers, metadata modalities, and ack/error envelopes. Update the discriminated union adapter usage in `unmute/main_websocket.py` and any helper modules that decode/emit events so the new types round-trip cleanly (including recorder serialization). Add focused unit tests (e.g., `tests/test_openai_realtime_events.py`) that load sample payloads from fixtures and ensure validation + `.model_dump()` parity with the Realtime spec.
